title: ScoringDiscrepNHL — NHL Scoring-Discrepancy Database & Detector
description: NHL scoring-discrepancy database and continuous detector covering goals changed to no-goals and back, scorer and assist corrections, and in-game, intermission and post-game corrections, with the original and corrected state preserved for every record. Its README states that the database holds 1,470 records — 1,449 live Situation Room records of which 1,396 are verified by statement plus play-by-play agreement and 53 are flagged for a human, 3 verified announcements, and 17 retired rows kept and marked rather than silently deleted — and that its own validate command reports 1,470 records. The directory repeats the repository’s stated counts and does not re-verify them.
